'''''KSE Firespray''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It depicted a [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft]]&mdash;a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designed by [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]]&mdash;patrolling an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''KSE Firespray'' was a painting that appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> which was released on [[June 26]], [[2003]]<ref name="Start">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20030617.html|text=''Galaxies'' to Release June 26}}</ref> and shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It was rewarded to players as part of the game's [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] ''30th Anniversary Celebration'' in [[May]] [[2010]]. Players received a container in their inventory after a "Double Everything Weekend"&mdash;which doubled the gain rate of experience points and other currency&mdash;and could use the container to be gifted with one of three paintings. The other two were [[X-Wing (painting)|''X-Wing'']] and [[Imperial Star Destroyer (painting)|''Imperial Star Destroyer'']]. The player could use the painting in their house as decoration.<ref name="SWG" /> The artwork for the painting comes from the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' expansion set ''[[Galactic Hunters]]'', specifically the card for the flagship of notorious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']].<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Slave I}}</ref>
